top_comments.body:
also getting this. I originally started in [session 1] with inputting an image that was too large.

I then scaled the image below the 5 mb and 8000 px requirement, but i kept getting the same error om [session 1].
then tried renaming the file, but still got the same error [session 1].
then spawned [session 2] fresh, and in this session it worked.
